folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B208, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The complete map, MC1–MC173, D1–D4, ceiling integration table and KJ2 uptake were reviewed. The supplement closes mapping for 39 later codes; it does not extend the original runtime inspection or prove the underlying methods. Source hashes and private-window counts identify historical inputs, not newly inspected primary text or current completeness. Preserve distinctions between declared agreement and enforcement, detection and attribution, body and agency, knowledge and custody, title/control/care/activation, and resource reservation versus actual irreversible work and delivery. A restored view must not silently refund spent material or erase acquired knowledge. These are selected mechanism questions, not a new all-world schema (AD6–AD8, AD32, AD51).

The later KJ2 section qualifies earlier absence claims for native receipts, actual vendor stock/purse, placed custody, connected participants and observer-safe labels. It also explicitly leaves historical borrowing, possession, rollback, dangerous reading and combat to later consumers. B153 records a later bounded method delivery and released writers; it does not prove the earlier physical-document carrier/destruction contract in D2 or the ceiling table. Keep B199’s scene/carrier and compatibility gaps where they still apply. The old 61% allowance stop, coordinator ownership and L2b assessment describe that investigation; they neither launch work nor impose a renewed project gate. Under AD51 an existing known consumer can justify a seam; a different world validates reuse rather than universally withholding extraction until two implementations.

MC169 and MC173 remain useful coverage discipline: pin situation/method/stage, trace intent through actual producer and command to result, inspect the admitted UI/control/return and failure alternative, then account for residue. Identified, specified, connected and journey-verified remain distinct denominators. No referenced runtime source, primary chapter, browser or persistence path was reverified in B208.
